_about: Discovery presentation derivation (List 22 #207). Two axes: LOCK (global, #197 — a species is on the roster with a number, or has no dex slot at all) x DISCOVERY (per-Ranger, #14's states over #1's seen_bits/met_bits). The presentation below is computed at read for one (species, Ranger) pair; nothing here is stored. Field gates are #3's table; the art rule at unseen is #14's canon implementation + the owner ruling of 2026-10-27 (silhouette, not withholding).

discovery_axis.note: No other system may move a discovery state. Garden visits (#212) are explicitly NOT a transition source.

lock_axis.source: #197 lock records / species record id + lock provenance
values: locked (number assigned at lock, in lock order)

open_slots: silhouette derivation for a locked species with no design of record yet (flagged to #197/#208)

kept.footprint: shown (or blank if the species has none)
kept.name: shown

unseen.art: silhouette (derived ink asset, #3 discovery_assets.py, from the marked-CURRENT cutout)
unseen.name: hidden

reveal.game: silhouette fills to full colour at the unseen->seen transition; the silhouette derives only from the marked-CURRENT design (current-version law)
reveal.show: #149 screen classes identify (assembling) + scan (registering); pacing light -> assemble -> settle; assemble order: silhouette before name before data, always
